confidence_notes: July Delhi price data supports meals and coffee; cocktail and wine estimates use roughly 3.5× and 2.75× the draft-beer price because standard pours are weakly covered. Hostel estimates are above [Hostelworld's listed starting fares](https://www.hostelworld.com/hostels/asia/india/new-delhi/f/city-center/) and account for two people in the private room; hotels are holistic estimates. See the [July Delhi price panel](https://novoexpat.com/cost-of-living-in_delhi-india/).
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink estimates are Delhi-specific, while hotel anchors reflect broad Delhi and Indian-capital costs.
